sql: SELECT count(*) rows,count(distinct tree_id) tree_ids,sum(tree_id IS NULL) missing_id,sum(zipcode IS NULL) missing_zip,sum(boroname IS NULL OR trim(boroname)='') missing_borough FROM trees
SELECT count(*) rows,count(distinct zipcode) zips,sum(zipcode IS NULL) missing_zip,sum(Estimate_Mean_income>0 AND Estimate_Median_income>0) positive FROM income_trees
SELECT boroname,count(*) n FROM trees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH combined AS (SELECT t.tree_id,t.boroname,coalesce(t.zipcode,i.zipcode) zipcode,i.Estimate_Median_income median_income,i.Estimate_Mean_income mean_income,i.Estimate_Total households FROM trees t FULL OUTER JOIN income_trees i ON t.zipcode=i.zipcode), eligible AS (SELECT * FROM combined WHERE median_income>0 AND mean_income>0 AND boroname IS NOT NULL AND trim(boroname)<>''), boroughs AS (SELECT boroname,count(tree_id) tree_count,avg(mean_income) average_mean_income FROM eligible GROUP BY boroname) SELECT * FROM boroughs ORDER BY tree_count DESC

SELECT * FROM income_trees WHERE zipcode IN (SELECT zipcode FROM income_trees GROUP BY zipcode HAVING count(*)>1) ORDER BY zipcode
SELECT tree_id,count(*) n,count(distinct zipcode) zips,count(distinct boroname) boroughs FROM trees GROUP BY tree_id HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) rows FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM trees)

SELECT t.boroname AS boroname,
       COUNT(*) AS tree_count,
       AVG(i.Estimate_Mean_income) AS avg_mean_income
FROM trees t
JOIN (SELECT zipcode,
             MAX(Estimate_Median_income) AS Estimate_Median_income,
             MAX(Estimate_Mean_income)   AS Estimate_Mean_income
      FROM income_trees
      GROUP BY zipcode) i
  ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode
WHERE i.Estimate_Median_income > 0
  AND i.Estimate_Mean_income > 0
  AND t.boroname IN ('Queens','Brooklyn','Staten Island','Bronx','Manhattan')
GROUP BY t.boroname
ORDER BY tree_count DESC
LIMIT 3
